title: Oil change. Let's paint!
content: We're stuck for an hour and a half in the waiting room of the tire place while the car gets an oil change and a tire rotation. The icy rain is coming down on the remnants of snow.Oil Change,gouache, 5 x 8 inches.Luckily I have a few tubes of gouache. I choose Prussian blue, perylene maroon, cadmium yellow deep, and white. I'm painting over a page primed with a violet-gray layer of casein. That color becomes the basic tone of the outside scene.The indoor scene is a study in warm and cool—cool on the horizontal planes that catch cool light from outdoors, and warm on the vertical planes facing into the room.The video shows the process.
